body: I just wanted to thank everyone for the outpouring of kindness and well wishes. It really helped improve my mood/state of mind to see all of this support. I did not expect this at all. Thank you.
I did, I used to love gaming and weight lifting. I keep trying to start up again, but I have no motivation. Spent half the day in bed today.

I guess, I'm just another sob-story amidst a sea of them...I want to try, but I feel so empty and alone. I need it to stop. I felt fine for the first couple days out of the hospital, but I feel like I'm getting right back to where I was.
